title: VTC Groups — Members — Remove — payload
description: A group manager removes a member from a static group: renewal of their group credential stops, and room admissions and grants that only this group provided are withdrawn. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Members — Remove — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/members/remove/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/members/remove/0.1#response.

state.description: `removed`: done. `pending`: a reduction of authority the community is holding for its cooling-off or consent.

credentialValidUntil.description: When the member's last group credential lapses; renewal has stopped. Null when they held none.
